Subject: Request: updated remediation status and proof for recent findings

Hi Rishi / Neha,

Following our SOC2 evidence review, Acme needs an updated, consolidated status for the vulnerability findings we discussed last week (IDs: AUTH-102, LOG-213, NET-78, SECRET-5). Specifically we need:  
- Short description of mitigation applied
- Current status (open/in-progress/closed)
- ETA for delivery of evidence artifacts (screenshots, config snippets, logs, screenshots of infra rules)

Can you include the pen-test report (or the addendum) from the external vendor if available, or confirm where it will be uploaded? Our compliance deadline is 2026-09-21 so we need this before then.

Alex Brown

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request: updated remediation status and proof for recent findings

Alex / Rishi / Grace —

Apologies for the delay. Below is the consolidated remediation status and short evidence plan for each finding. I attached a CSV checklist (remediation_checklist_20260904.csv) with links to internal tickets and owners.

1) AUTH-102 — Insecure session handling (issue discovered in token refresh path)
   - Status: in-progress
   - Mitigation implemented: rotated refresh token key, added stricter validation and TTL enforcement on refresh tokens (PR: infra/refresh-fix #324)
   - Short-term compensating control: rate limit refresh endpoint and enforced client certificate verification for internal clients
   - Evidence to provide: PR diff, unit + integration test run screenshot, staging logs showing invalid refresh attempts blocked
   - ETA for artifacts: 2026-09-10T17:00:00-07:00

2) LOG-213 — Insufficient retention + missing audit entry for role changes
   - Status: partially-closed (config change deployed for control-plane services; app-level instrumentation in deploy)
   - Mitigation implemented: increased retention to 180 days for audit logs (S3 lifecycle + bucket policy), added explicit audit events on role/grant endpoints
   - Evidence to provide: CloudTrail/S3 retention screenshot, sample audit event JSON, CloudWatch query showing new events
   - ETA for artifacts: 2026-09-08T12:00:00-07:00

3) NET-78 — Lateral access allowed between tenant staging networks
   - Status: remediation scheduled
   - Mitigation planned: apply micro-segmentation rules via firewall policies and update VPC routing to isolate tenant staging; testing in staging complete; rollout to prod scheduled in maintenance window
   - Evidence to provide: firewall rule snapshots, before/after network flow logs, maintenance window ticket (JIRA-SUP-4127)
   - ETA for artifacts: 2026-09-15T09:00:00-07:00

4) SECRET-5 — Secrets exposed in legacy repo history
   - Status: closed (rotated secrets and removed secrets from git history)
   - Mitigation implemented: secret scanning alerting, rotated all impacted keys, applied repo rewrite, enforced pre-commit hook on all repos
   - Evidence to provide: secret scan report (post-remediation), rotation logs, commit history scrub confirmation
   - ETA for artifacts: 2026-09-06T16:00:00-07:00 (already uploaded)

Attachments: remediation_checklist_20260904.csv (includes owner, ticket links, and evidence file names).

If you want more granular artifacts earlier for any single finding, flag it and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

From: CroweSec PT Team <crowesec-pt@crowesec.io>

Subject: CroweSec addendum and scope clarification for August engagement

Hi team,

Following your request, attached is the addendum for the August penetration test (crowesec-202608-addendum.pdf). Key notes:  
- We excluded full destructive tests against production tenant data stores per the agreed safety rules (see section 2.1).
- Several findings were scored as medium because exploit requires chained conditions; we recommend validation after your network segmentation rollout.
- We can re-run a targeted validation of NET-78 (lateral access) once you confirm the firewall rules are in prod — chargeable 4h retest.

Please advise if you want us to schedule the validation retest; we can send a formal quote.

Thanks,
Ava Collins
